standard_prerequisites.name: The local structure statement and the projective neighbourhood statement, with projectivity equal to freeness over a local ring
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter flat.tex, labels proposition-finite-type-flat-at-point (proof line 3491) and proposition-finite-presentation-flat-at-point (proof line 3494); Algebra, label algebra-theorem-projective-free-over-local-ring (proof line 3496)
standard_prerequisites.use: The first reduces to a module of finite presentation on a neighbourhood, the second provides the affine etale neighbourhood with projective global sections, and the third turns projectivity over the local base into freeness.

core_obligations: Reduce the base and the module: one may replace the base by an elementary etale neighbourhood and by the local ring at the point, so that by the local structure statement the module becomes finitely presented and flat on a neighbourhood of the point (proof lines 3487-3493).
Conclude by the finite presentation statement and freeness of projective modules over a local ring (proof lines 3493-3497).
proof_roadmap: Reduction to a finitely presented flat module on a neighbourhood (proof lines 3487-3493).
Finite presentation statement plus freeness (proof lines 3493-3497).
difficulty_reason: The lemma produces, for a finite type module flat at a point of a locally finitely presented morphism, an elementary etale neighbourhood and an affine etale neighbourhood of the point, with the same residue field, on which the pulled back module is finitely presented and has free global sections (statement lines 3460-3485, tag 05L9-adjacent). The proof reduces to the finite presentation case by passing to the local ring of the base at an etale neighbourhood and then invokes the finite presentation statement together with freeness of projective modules over a local ring. The reduction is the substance, so the claim is H2.
